title.zh: 【CFTC 主席解读新规：只有联邦监管的加密交易平台才能提供杠杆交易，但百倍杠杆不会被允许】
title.en: 【CFTC 主席解读新规：只有联邦监管的加密交易平台才能提供杠杆交易，但百倍杠杆不会被允许】

current_state.zh: CFTC Chair Michael Selig said under the agency's proposed rules only federally regulated crypto trading platforms could offer leveraged trading, that states would be limited to money transmission, and that 100x leverage would remain prohibited in the US.
current_state.en: CFTC Chair Michael Selig said under the agency's proposed rules only federally regulated crypto trading platforms could offer leveraged trading, that states would be limited to money transmission, and that 100x leverage would remain prohibited in the US.
